resources.string: DockClock can show your recent notifications next to the clock. To do that, turn on notification access for DockClock in Settings. Notifications stay on this phone: they are never saved, logged, or sent anywhere.
Show only the app name and icon on the clock.
Pick which apps can show notifications on the clock.
Show the clock automatically while the phone is charging. In Settings, choose DockClock as the screen saver and set it to start while charging. It appears when the screen would normally turn off.
